lore_anchors.definition: The primordial waters of the lunar star and the primordial flames of the solar star. When fused, they can weave a cocoon of energy that fundamentally reconstructs a Fiendgod Body Refiner’s physique.

A supreme divine ability beneath the True God level, trained through nine cycles of body refinement. Each three-cycle tier costs roughly a thousand times more resources than the previous, making the ninth cycle legendary.
A top-ten divine ability created by Daoist Threelives that treats the cultivator’s hands as ultimate weapons, capable of shattering defenses and crushing stars.
A trial structure within Daoist Threelives’s aquatic palace. The 7th and 8th levels grant Immortal-ranked treasures; the 9th and 10th grant Pure Yang treasures, with difficulty spiking accordingly.
The highest grade of magic treasure in the Three Realms, usable only by True Gods and Pure Yang True Immortals. Comparable to a Celestial Immortal’s ultimate trump card.
A supreme-grade Immortal-ranked ark that can match a True God’s speed and unleash the Fivefold Thunderlight, a technique on par with the Nine Heavens Divine-Poison Flame.
A set of 3,600 supreme-grade Immortal-ranked flying knives that form a devastating killing formation, overwhelming enemies through sheer quantity and formation synergy.
A set of 360 supreme-grade Immortal-ranked flying swords that manifests the ancient Starry Zhou Grand Formation, each sword striking with the force of a falling star.

surfaces: Crimsonbright Diagram of the Nine Heavens
lore_anchors.definition: The number-one Fiendgod Body Refining method in the Three Realms, divided into nine layers. The 18th layer triggers the Heavenly Tribulation, so cultivators typically stop at the 17th layer before facing it.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can’t Ji Ning use Pure Yang treasures yet?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Pure Yang treasures require a True God or Pure Yang True Immortal’s cultivation base to activate. Ji Ning is still below that threshold, so Immortal-ranked treasures remain his practical ceiling.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Eight-Nine Arcane Art’s resource cost?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Training from cycles 1–3 requires X resources; cycles 4–6 require 1000× X; cycles 7–9 require another 1000× that. The tenth cycle is the legendary limit, achieved by only a handful in the Three Realms.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the chapter include the War God Hall’s difficulty estimate?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It humbles Ji Ning despite his massive breakthrough, reminding readers that Celestial Immortals are still far from the peak of the Three Realms. The treasure vault is compensation for his current limitations.
